trigger_evidence.finding: Multiple informativeness batches failed because actual V.PhyloMaker2 species.list status counts disagreed with the vectorized v0.4.2 prune/bind approximation.

diagnosis: V.PhyloMaker2 binding status is not reducible to independent species membership in tree/genus/family sets. Its F1/F2 handling and binding logic depend on the complete species list supplied to phylo.maker.
correction: For every semantic-PASS family x trait system, construct the exact source-native species/genus/family list and run pinned V.PhyloMaker2 phylo.maker(..., scenarios='S3', output.sp.list=TRUE). Count status == prune, bind, fail to bind from the returned species.list. Apply the unchanged >=20 S3-resolvable and >=20 prune-only thresholds.
